description: This file defines a C++ wrapper class 'netlink_socket' around the Linux Netlink Protocol Library (libnl). It provides methods for connecting, closing, and performing request/response transactions over a netlink socket, facilitating IPC between kernel and user space. The class is designed to be extended for specific netlink protocols.

classes.name: netlink_socket
classes.description: A C++ wrapper class for managing a netlink socket, including connection, disconnection, and message exchange.

methods.name: netlink_socket
methods.description: Constructor that allocates the netlink socket structure with a specified protocol.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates and binds a new netlink socket to the specified protocol.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the netlink socket and frees resources.

methods.name: send_receive_msg
methods.description: Performs a request/response transaction by sending a message and handling the response via callbacks.
